bioconda.name: bioconductor-keggrest
bioconda.summary: Client-side REST access to the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG)

biotools.summary: A package that provides a client interface to the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) REST API. Only for academic use by academic users belonging to academic institutions (see <https://www.kegg.jp/kegg/rest/>). Note that KEGGREST is based on KEGGSOAP by J. Zhang, R. Gentleman, and Marc Carlson, and KEGG (python package) by Aurelien Mazurie.
